4312.title: Generic merge blocking hides waiting reasons
4312.rootCauseOneLine: Generic blocked mergeability wins before pending checks or outstanding reviews, and its display uses destructive coloring.
4312.proposedFix: Preserve specific waiting reasons, decide status semantics, and add auto-merge/queue data with public-contract compatibility coverage.
4312.caveats: Synthetic production-function/component reproduction, repeated logic in two clean trusted checkouts; no live GitHub polling or desktop verification. Full scope fails simple-fix limits.
